additional_requirements.title: Ensure all signed artifacts are validated upon uploading the package registry
additional_requirements.text: Validate every artifact with its signature before uploading it to the package registry. It is recommended to do so automatically.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure all versions of an existing artifact have their signatures validated
additional_requirements.text: For each artifact, sign and validate each version before uploading or using the artifact.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure changes in package registry configuration are audited
additional_requirements.text: Audit the changes to the package registry configuration.

additional_requirements.title: Ensure webhooks of the repository are secured
additional_requirements.text: For each webhook in use, change it to secured (over HTTPS).
